_comment: TDM few-step distillation (radiance/train_tdm.py) with role-based LoRA: one frozen 9.5B Radiance x0 base + a student adapter (standard lora_A/lora_B keys) + a fake-score adapter (lora_A_fake/lora_B_fake). Data-free w.r.t. images — the parquet dataset supplies captions (and preview ground truth). The student is a tdm_steps-step CFG-free sampler; the saved tdm_student_*.safetensors loads directly into inference.py --lora with --steps 4 and guidance 0. Works for every parallelism (override with --parallelism/--devices).
_comment_grad_ckpt: MUST stay true at this batch: RamTorch stage workers run forwards on their own threads where the driver's (thread-local) no_grad does not apply, so even infer() builds graphs and keeps activations alive — per-block checkpointing collapses that footprint (krea2 2026-08-18 probes). It also covers each NerfGLUBlock, whose [B*N, 49152] generated weights are the largest activation in the model.
_comment_batch: 2x8=16 in-flight samples at 1024px. Halved from chroma's 4x8 as a starting point: the same 4096 image tokens per sample, but the NeRF head adds a per-patch hypernetwork on top, so the last stage is the constraint. Raise it once the first run's peak-VRAM line is known.
_comment_lr: Demo recipe: fake-score LR ~5x the student LR, betas (0, 0.95), clip 1.0 on both. Chroma's halved LRs, carried over — at full LR (2e-5/1e-4) both chroma modes showed periodic loss spikes and grainy 4-step convergence.
_comment_tdm: tdm_steps = K (student sampling steps). tdm_cfg = teacher guidance baked into the student — NOTE this is external CFG against the empty prompt; the model's own guidance input stays 0 (Chroma1 convention, which radiance inherits). tdm_separate_intervals keeps each segment's diffused tau range non-overlapping (paper default); tdm_randmid is the demo's optional mid-point regularizer. tdm_huber enables the Pseudo-Huber surrogate objective for the student update.
_comment_decoupled: Decoupled DMD (arXiv:2511.22677): the DMD target splits as DM + (tdm_cfg-1)*CA with DM = x0_real - x0_fake (regularizer) and CA = x0_real - x0_unc (engine). tdm_ca_ratio = lam replaces the legacy sum with a normalized mix. null = legacy math.
_comment_ratio: !! WARNING (2026-08-21, reconfirmed 2026-08-23): DO NOT USE the ratio rescale — keep tdm_ca_ratio null (legacy math). Three chroma runs in ratio mode collapsed (loss_d exploding while previews degenerated). Legacy delta at cfg 3 is DM + 2*CA. See memory/worklog.md.
_comment_x0_eps: Note for readers: this trainer forces the x0->v residual epsilon to 0.0 (set_x0_eps), unlike train.py's 5e-2, because TDM reconstructs x0 = x - t*v and that identity only holds at eps = 0. Not configurable.
_comment_teacher: Teacher = Radiance x0 patch-16 base weights (bf16, native flow keys, 659 tensors).
_comment_data: TDM only consumes captions; images are loaded solely for preview ground truth, so worker count is modest.
